this place is located in Aziziya so quite far from haram but on the main road next to many restaurants and shopping areas. the hotel is very modern with big room sizes and many lifts. an hourly shuttle service is available which is good for all days except fridays. parking is free and it is on site/basement. I enjoyed staying here especially they allowed me early checkin and upgraded my room. P.S I faced a concern as when I booked this hotel, booking.com suggested a room good for 5 persons but it was not even fit for 3. Select superior guest room or better check with the hotel. Thank you Fouad for solving my problem.
